terms.comment: Our description, on the house pattern for toys (see toy version): saeptum, a fence or enclosure, also a fold for animals (Lewis & Short). No ancient name is known, and Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi–Bini give none.

phrases.latin: Manē in saeptō lūsōriō, dum cēnam coquō.
phrases.english: Stay in your playpen while I cook supper.

sources: Lewis & Short: saeptum · Lewis & Short: lusorius
Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi–Bini have no word for a playpen (searched under playpen, play pen, and Italian box, recinto).
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
